author: CaioDaumann
body:
#### PR description:

Adds a transformer-based photon ID to NanoAOD (EGM-26-002). **Draft**, for discussion with EGamma and XPOG.

- New `PhotonTransformerIDProducer` in `RecoEgamma/PhotonIdentification` :
  - inputs: ECAL crystals, preshower strips and PF candidates from MiniAOD;
  - TorchScript via `PhysicsTools/PyTorch`, one batch per event;
  - outputs: ValueMaps `score` and `feature0-3`.
- NanoAOD: new columns `Photon_transformerID` and `Photon_transformerIDFeat0-3`, Run 3 only. `PyTorchService` is added, plus DQM plots.
- Model files: cms-data/RecoEgamma-PhotonIdentification#NN.

Link to Indico Talk about the model: https://indico.cern.ch/event/1727818/#1-updates-on-photon-id-develop

#### PR validation:

- The new unit test passes. code-checks and code-format are clean.
- 10k events, CMSSW_17_0_0: same scores as the standalone implementation used for EGM-26-002. 99.9% are bit-identical; the rest differ by 1 bit.
- Cost: 6.6 ms/event (9.6% of the NanoAOD CPU), +21 B/event, and +0.49 GB memory, mostly libtorch.

Something that we need to discuss:  This is the first PyTorch model in standard NanoAOD. An ONNX version would avoid the extra memory.
title: Photon transformer
